image_prompt.text: Touchlines and goal lines built as a detection perimeter so play stops the moment the ball leaves the pitch
Centre circle kickoff spot, penalty spots and corner arcs as the reset positions for play
Goal mouths at both ends, drawn as goals and registering as scoring volumes
Full regulation pitch markings - halfway line, penalty area, six-yard box
Team benches and technical areas on the sideline for substitutes and the technician making them
Large tiered stands wrapping the pitch, which is what makes the stadium read as big
The stadium wall enclosing the pitch and keeping the bouncy ball in play

layout_placement.text: Out-of-play detection perimeter on the touchlines and goal lines
Kickoff, penalty and corner reset positions
Goal-line scoring volumes at each end

notes: Most of this prompt is roles, controls, animation sets, replay and bot AI - none of it has a spatial footprint. The layout job is the stadium and the pitch.
Team kits, shirt numbers and player names are character dressing rather than layout.
P0 + tiered: the bleachers are stepped relief with no overhang, but the height has to be captured or the stadium builds flat.

open_questions.ask: Should the stadium read as a modern broadcast arena, or something more stylised?
How big is big - a club ground or a full national stadium bowl?

coverage_missing.ask: Does the VAR role need a physical booth in the stadium, or is it purely off-field?

answers.ask: Should the stadium read as a modern broadcast arena, or something more stylised?
answers.answer: Use a modern broadcast-style soccer arena, matching the realistic match, VAR, replay, and team-kit setup.

answers.ask: How big is big - a club ground or a full national stadium bowl?
answers.answer: Make it a full national stadium bowl so it feels like a big professional soccer match venue.
